tasks.investor_question: What does this business actually sell into the theme?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Source-scoped business/product, application, ownership-effective date; matched revenue/profit denominator when disclosed
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Explain documented role and undisclosed purity; falsified by disposal, product withdrawal or narrower scope
tasks.prior_research_and_consumer: W1-W2/W2X; GMI evidence, Data OS identity, shared detail

tasks.investor_question: Does announced customer demand become supplier business?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Announcement, financing, reservation, order/RPO and cancellation definitions, project timing
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Show conditional demand transmission, not revenue forecast; failure is non-conversion or uneconomic terms
tasks.prior_research_and_consumer: W2/W5; relationship and native financial/operating evidence

tasks.investor_question: Is recovery end demand or dealer/channel replenishment?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Matching sell-in, sell-through, inventory stock and target where available; region and period
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Explain competing inventory/demand mechanisms; reject a retail-recovery claim based only on factory shipments
tasks.prior_research_and_consumer: W2-W3; business cycle panel, existing theme context

tasks.investor_question: Can orders become profitable deliveries?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Backlog cohort, accepted price/cost terms, qualified throughput, estimate changes, margin and cash
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Show conversion risks and retained economics; falsifier is overruns, cancellations or cash absorption

tasks.investor_question: Who benefits when aerospace durability changes?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Maintenance-obligation holder, billing basis, active hours/cycles, work completion and compensation
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Explain role-dependent direction; reject universal positive repair-demand interpretation

tasks.investor_question: Does new equipment create valuable future service?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Installation investment, eligible active cohorts, paid attachment, renewal, net service contribution and timing
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Finite scenario with visible delay/cost exposure; falsifier is weaker attachment, durability economics or early retirement
tasks.prior_research_and_consumer: W4/W6; existing forecast/scenario owner plus evidence

tasks.investor_question: Why would the customer replace rather than repair, buy used or rent?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Comparable workload, installed cost, operating savings, trade value, funding and horizon
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Explain customer decision threshold; falsifier is attractive alternatives or financing constraint

tasks.investor_question: Does rental growth earn back the fleet?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Purchase cohort, utilization/rate/mix, maintenance, disposal and full investment perimeter
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Lifetime return scenario rather than EBITDA-only ranking; adverse residuals or capital inflation can break it

tasks.investor_question: Is distributor growth profitable after serving the customer?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Daily sales, account/product mix, service costs, receivables/inventory and supplier terms
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Show contribution and capital absorption; falsifier is discounts or funding growing faster than economics
tasks.prior_research_and_consumer: W3; customer contribution and cash bridge

tasks.investor_question: Is freight improving physically or only in reported revenue?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Shipments/tonnage/loads, period-matched yield, fuel, mix, network costs and reinvestment
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Separate activity from invoices; falsifier is pass-through/mix rather than density/productivity

tasks.investor_question: Does a broker retain more profit per transaction?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Transactions, gross profit, purchased transport, full operating costs and denominator
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Compare broker contribution without mixing carrier revenue margins; falsifier is spread compression or service loss

tasks.investor_question: Is recurring service becoming more durable?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Defined paid cohort, renewal/exit, realized price, covered obligations, full cost-to-serve
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Conditional retained-contribution model; no inferred retention from total revenue

tasks.investor_question: Do consumables and certification relationships replenish themselves?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Active instruments/certificates, use, recurring fees, new cohort entry and exits, quality/capacity
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Explain repeat demand versus customer replacement burden; falsifier is cohort attrition or costly replenishment

tasks.investor_question: Will retrofit economics persuade the party paying?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Adjusted no-project baseline, measured benefit, payer/beneficiary, disruption, horizon and installed cost
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Customer-benefit scenario with split-incentive limits; falsifier is unsupported baseline or inadequate captured benefit

tasks.investor_question: Does local service density improve contribution?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Compatible geographic work, stops/accounts, resource capacity, retention, prices and full route/service cost
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Show local capacity thresholds, not uniform scale economies; falsifier is churn or costly resource additions

tasks.investor_question: Does the water contract reward conservation and reliable supply?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Volume versus availability/outcome payment, cost structure, obligations, penalties and capital
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Explain customer/provider incentive alignment; failure is lower usage undermining fixed-cost coverage

tasks.investor_question: Is payroll growth service quality or client-funds income?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Retained service fees, client balances/obligations, maturity vintages, yield and financing costs
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Separate service economics and net interest; never treat client principal as excess equity cash

tasks.investor_question: What drives professional-employer-service profit?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Fees, benefits pass-through, insurance revenue/cost, risk-bearing population and claims basis
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Separate administration growth from insurance contribution; falsifier is unfavorable risk development

tasks.investor_question: Is staffing improvement hours, wage pass-through or comparison charges?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Accepted hours, bill/pay rates, repricing lag, mix, recruiting cost, receivables and prior charges
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Show spread and funding of recovery; falsifier is lower hours or wage/collection pressure

tasks.investor_question: Who keeps outsourcing/automation productivity savings?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Outcome/transaction/hour billing, customer concession, labor saved, tool/migration cost, volume and quality
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Transition-versus-steady contribution; falsifier is customer repricing, volume erosion or migration burden

tasks.investor_question: Is transport capital earning through a full capacity cycle?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Fleet/asset availability, trip times or passenger usage, concession terms, commissioning, leases, depreciation and cash interest
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Separate current scarcity or accounting transition from lifecycle returns

tasks.investor_question: Does portfolio change improve the shareholder's claim?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Effective ownership, purchase price, organic/acquired split, finance, dilution, corporate costs and minority claims
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Reconcile business improvement to equity cash; falsifier is overpayment or financing absorbing benefits

tasks.investor_question: What changed relative to a genuinely dated expectation?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Same measure, basis, fiscal endpoint, contributor/issuer source, vintage, publication window and intervening events
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Separate guidance, external aggregate, house forecast and scenario; refuse verdict when comparison unsupported

tasks.investor_question: Does the thesis improve forecasts or explain stock mispricing?
tasks.evidence_and_boundary: Predeclared universe/horizon, immutable prediction and input vintage, matched outcomes, valid prices/actions, baseline and costs when relevant
tasks.useful_output_and_falsifier: Report calibrated and held-out evidence only when run; failure includes missing coverage or baseline dominance
